fx_lock.source: European Central Bank reference rates via frankfurter.app

hourly_usd_all.ci_method: percentile bootstrap over hosts, 10000 iterations, seed 20260903

us_monthly_native.ci_method: percentile bootstrap over hosts, 10000 iterations, seed 20260903

hours_sensitivity.note: 12h was the median of the raw hours_included column before the audit, when hours per week and days per month were being read as hours per month

publish_rate.definition: hosts with a publishable rate for the role, over hosts whose captured pages mention that role

methodology.publication_gate: evidence and plausibility. Every published number is found word for word in a quote captured from the provider's own page, together with its currency and its cadence, and sits inside a per-unit plausibility band.
methodology.confidence_columns: strict_pass and dual_agreement are reported as a confidence tier per record (high = both, medium = one, low = neither). They no longer remove a row from the index.
methodology.value_basis: midpoint of a published range, labelled midpoint; a single figure is labelled published

normalisation.per_month: divided by the hours the provider publishes where it publishes them, otherwise by 32.5 hours per month
normalisation.hours_per_day_basis: 8. Corroborated on sackermanconsulting.com, which prices 4h as a half-day, 8h as a full day and 12h as a day and a half
normalisation.default_hours_source: host-level median of the 41 hours_included readings that survived the manual audit of all 51 (10 rejected: 3 SLA cells, 3 undefined 'units', 2 per-working-day intensities, 1 plan name, 1 bundled intern allowance)
normalisation.currency: converted at the locked ECB reference rate of 2026-09-03. Both the original currency and the USD-per-hour figure are published.

methodology.grouping: region is derived from the currency the provider quotes in, not from where the provider is. A country column derived from the ccTLD is published beside it and is empty for the ~90% of hosts on a .com.
methodology.dedup: one host contributes one value per group, the median of its own offers in that group
methodology.reporting_floor: a group is published only at n >= 8 hosts. Smaller groups are counted and named but carry no figure.

quality_flags.self_inclusion: saasfractionalcpo.com, the publisher of this index, is one of the sampled providers ($8,000/month, 20-25 hours). It is one host out of 175 and is not excluded.
quality_flags.region_is_currency: regions US/UK/EU are currency buckets. A US provider quoting in euros lands in EU.
known_limitations: the hours default is measured on 21 hosts that publish hours; providers that publish hours may not be typical of those that do not
a monthly retainer is not literally a block of hours, so the hourly equivalent is a comparison device, not a quotable rate
ccTLD resolves a country for roughly one host in ten
